newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Dec 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Dec 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- French ambassador says low level of French investment in Saudi Arabia was caused by information gap. France to hold an exhibition on the kingdom next year.
- Import of garage and gas station equipment from India being studied.
- Arabian Investment Co to raise capital to $400 million from $300 million.
- Health minister to open four projects in the Eastern Province next week.
- Alujain plans to raise its capital to 400 million riyals and its shares will be traded in the Saudi market in the first quarter of 1997.
